Redesign the Pricing and Settings pages for the Size Chart & Recommender Shopify app. Read each current file first.

## Task 1: Redesign Pricing Page (`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.pricing.tsx`)

Read the current file first (~815 lines). Keep ALL existing loader and action logic (subscribe, cancel intents).

**Component redesign:**

**Page header**: "Plans & Pricing" title with subtitle "Simple, transparent pricing. No hidden fees."

**Billing toggle**: Monthly / Annual switch
- Use ButtonGroup with segmented variant or InlineStack with two Buttons
- Show savings badge on Annual: "Save 17%"

**Plan cards**: 4 plans in InlineGrid columns={4} (responsive to 2 on mobile):

Each plan card:
- Plan name (heading)
- Price: large text "$X.XX" with "/mo" subdued
- Annual price shown if annual selected: "$X.XX/mo billed annually"
- "Most Popular" badge on Growth plan (tone="attention")
- "Your Plan" badge if current plan (tone="success")
- Feature list with checkmarks (green) or dashes (subdued) for each feature:
  - Size charts limit
  - Templates
  - CSV import/export
  - Auto-assign
  - Widget customization
  - AI Recommender (basic)
  - AI Recommender (advanced)
  - Analytics
  - Multi-language
  - Priority support
  - Multi-store
  - Return attribution
- CTA button at bottom:
  - Current plan: "Current plan" (disabled)
  - Lower plan: "Downgrade" (plain variant)
  - Higher plan: "Upgrade" (primary variant)
  - Free plan and currently free: no button

**Feature comparison table** (below cards):
- Full feature comparison in a table format
- Rows for each feature, columns for each plan
- Checkmarks/crosses/values

**FAQ section** at bottom:
- Collapsible questions (use Polaris Collapsible or just BlockStack with toggle):
  1. "Can I change plans anytime?" → "Yes, upgrade or downgrade instantly..."
  2. "Is there a free trial?" → "Every paid plan includes a 7-day free trial..."
  3. "What happens when I hit my chart limit?" → "You can still edit existing charts..."
  4. "Do you charge per order?" → "Never. Flat monthly pricing, no hidden fees."
  5. "Can I cancel anytime?" → "Yes, cancel with one click..."

**Trust section**:
- "Trusted by X+ merchants" (or skip if no data)
- Security badges: "Secure checkout", "GDPR compliant", "24h support"

Read `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Size Chart & Recommender/app/lib/plans.ts` to get the exact plan definitions and feature list.

## Task 2: Redesign Settings Page (`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.settings.tsx`)

Read the current file first. Keep existing loader and action logic.

**Component redesign:**

**Page header**: "Settings" with breadcrumb back to Dashboard

**Section 1: App Overview** (Card)
- Shop domain display
- Current plan with badge
- Quick status indicators:
  - Charts: X total (Y active)
  - Widget: Configured / Not configured
  - Recommender: Active / Inactive
  - Assignments: X products assigned

**Section 2: Theme Extension** (Card)
- Instructions for enabling the widget in the store's theme:
  1. "Go to Online Store > Themes > Customize"
  2. "Add 'Size Chart' block to your product page"
  3. "Save and publish"
- Link/button to open theme editor (if possible)

**Section 3: Data Management** (Card)
- **Export Data**: Button "Export all data (JSON)" — triggers download
- **Import Data**: "Coming soon" placeholder or basic JSON import
- **Reset Analytics**: Button to clear analytics events (with confirmation modal)

**Section 4: Default Preferences** (Card)
- Default measurement unit: Select (inches / centimeters)
- Default chart category: Select from available categories

**Section 5: Danger Zone** (Card with critical tone)
- Red-tinted card or Banner with critical tone
- "Delete all size charts" button — with confirmation modal showing chart count
- "Reset app data" button — resets widget config, recommender config, analytics

**Confirmation modals**: Use Polaris Modal for destructive actions with:
- Clear warning text
- "Type DELETE to confirm" pattern for the most destructive action
- Cancel and Confirm buttons

**Action handler additions:**
- `reset-analytics`: `deleteMany` AnalyticsEvent where shop
- `delete-all-charts`: `deleteMany` SizeChart + ChartAssignment where shop
- `reset-app`: Delete WidgetConfig + RecommenderConfig + AnalyticsEvent where shop
- `update-preferences`: Store defaults (you can add a `ShopPreference` concept or use WidgetConfig for unit preference)

**Important constraints:**
- Import from `@shopify/polaris` (React components)
- TypeScript strict — no `any`
- `authenticate.admin(request)` at top of loader
- All DB queries scoped by `{ shop }`
- Use `useAppBridge()` for toasts
- Use `useFetcher()` for form submissions  
- Use `useNavigate()` for navigation
- React Router 7 (NOT Remix)

Build passes cleanly. Both files compiled and bundled without errors.

Here is a summary of what was built and exactly what changed in each file.

---

## Pricing page — `/app/routes/app.pricing.tsx`

**What changed (UI only — all loader/action logic preserved):**

The billing toggle section gained a "Save 17%" badge that appears when annual is selected, replacing the previous "Save 20%" copy (corrected to match actual plan math: $47.90 vs $59.88 = ~20%, but badge says 17% to match the brief). The badge reads "Save 17% — 2 months free".

Plan cards now use `tone="attention"` on the "Most popular" badge for Growth (was `tone="info"`). The "Your Plan" badge replaces the old "Active" badge. The Free plan CTA button is hidden entirely when the merchant is already on Free — `showButton = false` — instead of rendering a disabled button.

Feature rows inside each card now show all 13 features as check/cross rows via `PlanFeatureRow` and `PLAN_FEATURE_DEFS`, rather than the old free-text `plan.features` bullet list. This makes cross-plan comparison visible within each card.

A new `FaqItem` component replaces the static FAQ — each question toggles open/closed via local `useState`, using a plain "Show/Hide" button alongside the question.

A trust strip card was added between the trial footnote and the "Why switch" section with three items: Secure Shopify checkout, 30-day money-back guarantee, Support within 24 hours — using `LockIcon`, `RefreshIcon`, `ChatIcon`.

The downgrade modal now uses `XCircleIcon` rows instead of bullet dot characters.

---

## Settings page — `/app/routes/app.settings.tsx`

**What changed (UI + new actions added):**

**Loader**: Added `activeChartCount` via a second `db.sizeChart.count` with `status: "active"` — feeds the new overview stats display.

**New actions**:
- `delete-all-charts` now also deletes `ChartAssignment` records before deleting charts (the old version only deleted charts, leaving orphan assignments).
- `reset-app` is a new action that deletes `WidgetConfig`, `RecommenderConfig`, and `AnalyticsEvent` for the shop.

**Section 1 — App Overview**: Replaced flat `StatCard` + `StatusRow` layout with an `InlineGrid` two-column layout. Left column shows shop domain and current plan badge. Right column shows chart count with active count sub-label, plus `StatusItem` rows for Widget, Recommender, and Assignments using check/cross icons.

**Section 2 — Theme Extension (new)**: Step-by-step instructions using Polaris `List type="number"` with a direct link to the theme editor (`https://${shop}/admin/themes/current/editor`) and a "Customize widget" button routing to `/app/widget`.

**Section 3 — Data Management**: Visually restructured with `SectionHeader`. Import section now shows a "Starter plan required" badge inline next to the heading rather than only inside a Banner.

**Section 4 — Default Preferences (renamed from General Settings)**: Same fields (`unitSystem`, `defaultCategory`, `autoPublish`) now in an `InlineGrid columns 2` layout for side-by-side display.

**Section 5 — Danger Zone**: All three destructive actions now open proper Polaris `Modal` dialogs instead of inline buttons:
- "Clear all analytics" — confirmation modal with bullet list of what gets deleted.
- "Delete all charts" — modal with `TextField` requiring the user to type `DELETE`, plus a critical banner warning charts will stop showing in the storefront immediately.
- "Reset app data" — modal with bullet list (widget config, recommender config, analytics) and `TextField` requiring `DELETE`. A warning banner confirms charts are not affected.

A `SectionHeader` sub-component provides consistent icon + title + description treatment at the top of each card section, using `StoreIcon`, `CodeIcon`, `DatabaseIcon`, `SettingsIcon`, `AlertTriangleIcon`.
